layer_organic_rule: features sharing the same transformer layer form one fixed group

ghost_geometry.formula: per selected layer l: 1-cos(h_l,h_{l+1}) and cos(h_l,h_final)
ghost_geometry.layer_policy: floor(0.1L) through ceil(0.9L), transitions ending before upper bound
ghost_geometry.literature_basis: Mao et al. (ACL 2026): adjacent-layer angular turbulence and premature similarity to the final state distinguish confused and stubborn hallucinations
ghost_geometry.readout: fixed-seed 256-D Gaussian projection of the mean generated-token residual state; response-level proxy, not paper-exact token states

module_conflict.formula: per layer, standard deviation across attention/MLP/residual token-mean entropy, target NLL, and top-1 surprisal
module_conflict.literature_basis: TriLens: attention, MLP, and residual logit-lens entropy pathways carry complementary evidence and may disagree while settling
module_conflict.readout: mean over generated-token positions before module dispersion

prediction_revision.formula: per transition l-1->l: |delta entropy|, positive target-NLL regression, positive top1-surprisal regression, and KL(current||final)
prediction_revision.literature_basis: DoLa and Jiang et al.: factuality is reflected by prediction changes between premature and mature layers
prediction_revision.readout: mean over generated-token positions before depth difference

target_commitment.formula: x_l = mean_t[-log p_l(generated_token_t)] on residual stream
target_commitment.literature_basis: Jiang et al. (NAACL 2024): generated-token probability evolves differently across depth for correct and hallucinated facts

orientation: fixed risk signs, globally oriented only by final-layer target-token NLL
success_rule: a discovery candidate must beat its evaluation-only per-cell best-layer oracle and the existing TriLens grouped-L2-probe macro AUROC; independent confirmation is still mandatory
